user_query: Analyze this sequence for conserved domains and motifs, identify the most likely protein family and cellular function, and distinguish strong evidence from homology-based inference. Pay attention to DNA/RNA-binding motifs, oligomerization, catalytic residues, and subcellular localization.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
